findings.one_line: The load-bearing uniform bound (5) is asserted after an unspecified rational-function cancellation: neither the numerator nor a checkable certificate is supplied, so the claimed all-t shifted-support L2 second-derivative bound (and hence the explicit Hellinger constant) cannot be reproduced from the declared dependencies.

The K3 and C4 upper bounds rest entirely on asserted QE implications (4) and (7), but the projection polynomials, isolating/sign data, or an independently checkable certificate are absent; the displayed witnesses establish only lower bounds, not v_K3 and v_C4.
